_about: Hand labels for context_notes.csv, written by reading each note, independent of the LLM. 'increase' = the note says freight costs went up on these routes. 'end' is only scored for increase notes (null = open-ended).

N001.why: flooding Feb 24 - Mar 8, higher trip costs; passable again Mar 9

N003.why: diesel up 5-7% on all routes from this week, no end given

N004.why: trap: new toll, but affected routes are not in this dataset

N005.why: trap: maintenance delays, costs not significantly affected

N009.why: trap: route back to normal after flood repairs

N010.why: trap: compliance cost absorbed without a rate change
